geometry_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant body from a generic bent bar to a section-aware mass so the roof/section can carry program meaning.
Use a folded section to improve silhouette and section clarity without turning the building into arbitrary stepped tiers.
Align the section logic with the long direction of the compact host to preserve the dominant gesture.
Introduce a direct public void attached to the dominant mass so the access edge becomes spatially explicit.
Promote the void-bearing composition so the street threshold becomes primary while the hall remains in ancestry.
Set a usable carve depth that will be visible as a consequential open space.
Open the void toward the verified access side to repair the public threshold relation.

graph_edits.rationale: Retain the dominant compact mass but make the section read more clearly as a neighborhood building rather than a generic block.
Reduce the bend intensity so the main volume stays calm and continuous while keeping a legible massing gesture.
Increase continuity in the executable path to avoid a blunt, stair-like reading and support a smoother mass transition.
Add a ground-level void tied to the dominant mass so the access edge becomes public and legible.
Make the carve substantial enough to read as usable open space rather than decorative subtraction.
Orient the public opening to the program-frame access side to repair the street relationship.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent compact mass and reads consistently across the four views, but its current state is still predominantly a generic extruded volume with a mild bent/rounded top. The parcel containment appears acceptable and the dominant gesture is readable, yet the verified access edge is not answered with a legible void, undercut, court, or seam. That is the main program failure for neighborhood living, which explicitly asks for an active ground threshold and some public open-space figure. The silhouette is modestly resolved but not yet meaningfully sectional; the form does not rise to the reference family’s court/terrace/public-threshold logic. Because the mass is coherent and repairable, it is not a hard geometry failure, but it does not hard-pass program fit.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference has much stronger courtyard/public-threshold logic than the candidate; do not copy its curved parapet language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise composition with a central void and an upper connector can support a neighborhood program while keeping the ground legible.
